sn55.22:2.1: Mā bhāyi Mahānāma ma bhāyi Mahānāma
sn55.22:2.2: apāpakaṃ te maraṇam bhavissati apāpikā kālakiriyā || ||
sn55.22:2.3: Catuhi kho Mahānāma dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro ||
sn55.22:2.5: Idha Mahānāma ariyasāvako Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti ||
sn55.22:2.6: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti ||
sn55.22:2.9: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti || akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || || 6.
sn55.22:3.1: Seyyathāpi Mahānāma rukkho pācinaninno pācīnapoṇo pācīnapabbhāro || so mūle chinne katamena papateyyā ti || ||
sn55.22:3.2: Yena bhante ninno yena poṇo yena pabbhāro ti || ||
sn55.22:3.3: Evam eva kho Mahānāma imehi catuhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako nibbhānaninno nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro
